description: Resume nearest token-matrix unions after excluding its first scored-sensitive pair
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,687 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 32 prior macro-attempts and 427 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0089/micro-0008 at 1,687 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0089/micro-0009, whose QKV union scored 98.99%. At the token site specifically, attempt-0081/micro-0006 retained 1,784 parameters and micro-0007's (55,92) union scored 98.97%. Hypothesis: that token failure is coordinate-specific rather than a universal token-difference boundary; excluding exactly (55,92) and resuming ascending current token-group difference can find a neutral alternative. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than another QKV exclusion branch because it revisits a distinct representation whose rejected pair and subsequent ordering have not been tested. Each micro-trial adds one eligible token union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at 20 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: The revised token branch stopped on its first eligible alternative. Excluding the prior (55,92) failure exposed groups (93,160); their union proposed 1,686 parameters but scored 0.77%, so it was discarded and rolled back. Frontier remained 1,687 parameters at 99.01%; 0 accepts, 1 scored discard, 0 errors. Compute used one checkpoint migration and one official verification over 1m19s wall clock. Stop reason: first scored failure closed the revised token path before the 20-trial/30-minute cap.
